skills.name: Normal Attack
skills.gameText: Deals 140% ATK damage to targets within range. After the attack hits, has a 20% chance to grant self for 3 sec, [Top] Shield.

skills.name: Undying Vitality
skills.gameText: Permanently grants self [Top] ATK Increase and [Top] DEF Increase, Action Impairment Barrier, Critical Shield.

skills.name: Resurgent Calamity
skills.gameText: Every 8 sec, deals 650% ATK damage to all enemies. After the attack hits, inflicts [Top] Burn and [Top] Paralysis, [Top] DEF Decrease, [Top] Critical Damage Decrease, Heal Block on the target for 4 sec.

skills.name: Demon from the Book of Zeref
skills.gameText: Every 6 sec, has a 30% chance to inflict Bind and [Top] Bleed, Silence on all enemies for 3 sec.
